## ChatGPT & Codex changelog — NEW THIS SCAN (cache previously stopped at Aug 7)

### August 13, 2026 — **Computer History** (opt-in, macOS desktop app)  [reported 2026-08-14]
Turns activity across apps and websites into **memories and a timeline** that ChatGPT and Codex can
use. Records interaction events exposed through **macOS accessibility features**: clicks, typing,
keyboard shortcuts, and app switching. Explicitly does NOT capture screenshots, screen recordings,
microphone input or system audio — it **replaces the Chronicle research preview**, which was
screenshot-based, and is described as a rebuilt system rather than a rename.
Data handling: interaction events stored **on the Mac for up to 48 hours**; events are processed on
**OpenAI's servers** to generate memories, not retained after processing and not used for training;
the resulting **plain-text memory files stay local until deleted**.
Availability: ChatGPT **Pro, Business and Enterprise**; **administrator enablement required for
workspace members**. Excluded at launch: EEA, Switzerland, UK.

### August 11, 2026  [both reported 2026-08-14]
- **Linux desktop app (preview)** — Ubuntu, Debian and Fedora, x64 and ARM64, via `.deb` / `.rpm`.
- **Import external agent setup** — imports configuration from **Claude Code, Claude Cowork and
  Cursor**, including "settings, skills, plugins, projects, and recent work", with automatic
  synchronization options.

### August 10, 2026 — **Daybreak Blue and Daybreak Red tiers**  [reported 2026-08-14]
Two new access tiers in OpenAI's Daybreak "Trusted Access for Cyber" program.
- **Daybreak Blue** — defensive work on **GPT-5.6 Sol** with Trusted Access for Cyber. Approved
  workflows: secure code review, vulnerability triage, detection engineering, incident response,
  malware analysis, patch validation.
- **Daybreak Red** — advanced defensive AND **offensive** cyber tasks, with access to
  purpose-trained models **GPT-5.5-Cyber and GPT-5.6-Cyber**: vulnerability research, exploit
  validation, security testing.
- OpenAI's own published evaluation: **GPT-5.6-Cyber answered 95% of advanced cybersecurity prompts**
  (exploit-chain development, authentication bypass, privilege escalation) versus **1.5% for GPT-5.6
  Sol with default protections.**
  openai.com/index/expanding-daybreak-as-the-cyber-defense-window-narrows/ ; openai.com/daybreak/

### August 7, 2026 — Codex CLI 0.147.0  [reported 2026-08-07]
Portable Agent Plugins installation, persistent thread sections, MCP 2026-07-28 protocol support,
Cursor skill migration, Amazon Bedrock web search/compaction.

## OpenAI Python SDK releases — advanced since the 2026-08-07 capture (v2.53.0)
- **v3.0.0 (Aug 12, 2026)** — BREAKING: HTTPX2 is now the default HTTP client and `httpx` is no
  longer installed automatically; custom HTTPX clients must migrate or use a legacy escape hatch.
  [infrastructure — below the reporting bar]
- **v2.54.0 (Aug 11, 2026)** — new response model identifiers; audio upload doc clarification.
  [below bar]
Standing caution (from the 2026-08-07 scan): SDK release-note wording lags and MISLABELS model
families — corroborate model launches against openai.com/index/* and the ChatGPT/Codex changelog.
